_doc: Edge-envelope GPU-only baseline for the Jetson AGX Orin software path described in the evaluation section. ONNXim does not model CUDA/Tensor-Core scheduling directly, so the executable proxy keeps the committed c4_128x128 topology and uses two 800 MHz 32 B DDR channels as a conservative 102.4 GB/s memory slice. The paper-facing GPU path remains marked as a GPU software proxy, not as a mobile NPU, so fast replay does not apply Mobile-NPU matrix/vector service parallelism to it. PIM and AHASD controls are disabled: drafting and verification alternate on the same GPU memory path.
